newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China power plant to issue 120-mln-yuan bond.
newsitem.headline: China power plant to issue 120-mln-yuan bond.

text.p: Shanxi Yangquan Power Plant has received approval from the People's Bank of China to issue 120 million yuan in bonds and list them on the Shenzhen stock exchange in 1997, an official involved in the issue said.

The three-year bonds, priced at a par value of one yuan, will be launched early next year, an official at China Southern Securities Co Ltd, the main underwriter, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin on Wednesday.
He declined to give the annual interest rate on the bonds.
The power plant, in Yangquan in coal-rich Shanxi province in central China, aims to use money raised from the issue to upgrade production facilities, he said but gave no more details.
